samples.xml_description:
<module id="asyn_fifo">
    <description>Asynchronous FIFO with configurable depth and width.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="wclk">Write clock signal.</input>
        <input id="rclk">Read clock signal.</input>
        <input id="wrstn">Write reset signal.</input>
        <input id="rrstn">Read reset signal.</input>
        <input id="winc">Write increment signal.</input>
        <input id="rinc">Read increment signal.</input>
        <input id="wdata" width_description="[WIDTH-1:0]">Write data input.</input>
        <output id="wfull">Write full signal.</output>
        <output id="rempty">Read empty signal.</output>
        <output id="rdata" width_description="[WIDTH-1:0]">Read data output.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="WIDTH">8</parameter>
        <parameter id="DEPTH">16</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <register id="waddr_bin" width_description="$clog2(DEPTH)">Write address register.</register>
        <register id="raddr_bin" width_description="$clog2(DEPTH)">Read address register.</register>
        <register id="wptr" width_description="$clog2(DEPTH)">Write pointer register.</register>
        <register id="rptr" width_description="$clog2(DEPTH)">Read pointer register.</register>
        <register id="wptr_buff" width_description="$clog2(DEPTH)">Write pointer buffer.</register>
        <register id="rptr_buff" width_description="$clog2(DEPTH)">Read pointer buffer.</register>
        <wire id="wen" width_description="1">Write enable signal.</wire>
        <wire id="ren" width_description="1">Read enable signal.</wire>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        // Dual-port RAM instantiation
        <submodule id="dual_port_RAM">
            <port id="wclk">Write clock signal.</port>
            <port id="renc">Read enable signal.</port>
            <port id="waddr">Write address.</port>
            <port id="wdata">Write data.</port>
            <port id="rclk">Read clock signal.</port>
            <port id="wenc">Write enable signal.</port>
            <port id="raddr">Read address.</port>
            <port id="rdata">Read data.</port>
        </submodule>

        // Write pointer management
        always @(posedge wclk or negedge wrstn) begin
            if (!wrstn) begin
                waddr_bin <= 0;
            end else if (winc && !wfull) begin
                waddr_bin <= waddr_bin + 1;
            end
        end

        // Read pointer management
        always @(posedge rclk or negedge rrstn) begin
            if (!rrstn) begin
                raddr_bin <= 0;
            end else if (rinc && !rempty) begin
                raddr_bin <= raddr_bin + 1;
            end
        end

        // Gray code conversion
        assign wptr = waddr_bin ^ (waddr_bin >> 1);
        assign rptr = raddr_bin ^ (raddr_bin >> 1);

        // Pointer buffers
        always @(posedge wclk or negedge wrstn) begin
            if (!wrstn) begin
                wptr_buff <= 0;
            end else begin
                wptr_buff <= wptr;
            end
        end

        always @(posedge rclk or negedge rrstn) begin
            if (!rrstn) begin
                rptr_buff <= 0;
            end else begin
                rptr_buff <= rptr;
            end
        end

        // Full and empty signals
        assign wfull = (wptr == {~rptr[most_significant_bit(rptr)], rptr[$clog2(DEPTH)-2:0]});
        assign rempty = (rptr == wptr);

        // Data write controller
        assign wen = winc && !wfull;

        // Data read controller
        assign ren = rinc && !rempty;

        // Connect to dual-port RAM
        dual_port_RAM.wclk <= wclk;
        dual_port_RAM.renc <= ren;
        dual_port_RAM.waddr <= wptr;
        dual_port_RAM.wdata <= wdata;
        dual_port_RAM.rclk <= rclk;
        dual_port_RAM.wenc <= wen;
        dual_port_RAM.raddr <= rptr;
        rdata <= dual_port_RAM.rdata;
    </implementation>
</module>
